{{Quote|[The Sith] dwelled close to the five major places where they performed their Mysteries. Each settlement was located near an elaborate lava cave system that had a specific focus...this one here, in a very temperate zone—the one that hosted what was called the High Rites—might be the most significant area to explore. Only the highest-ranking Sith—the ones strongest in the Force—conducted rituals here.|[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Natua Wan]], [[44 ABY]]|<ref name="FotJ:A">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref>}}
The '''High Rites''' were a series of ancient [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith rituals]] and [[Sith acolyte/Legends|acolyte]] initiations that were considered part of the [[Upekzar]] [[Mysteries]]. Like the [[Rites of Fire]] and the [[Cold Rites]] conducted by the ancient [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] at other sites along the [[Circle of Visions]], the High Rites were undertaken within an elaborate [[High Rites cave system|volcanic cave system]] and involved the use of the [[rhak-skuri]], an insectoid subspecies of [[diplura]] whose [[Pheromone/Legends|pheromones]] were known to generate nightmare-like hallucinations in certain [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] species. Unlike the other rites, however, the High Rites were only conducted by the strongest [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force users]] on Upekzar, most of whom lived in a [[Abandoned city of the Sith|city]] three [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] away from the cave system in the shadow of a dormant volcano.<ref name="FotJ:A" />
